# Bismi Boutique

Bismi Boutique is an online fashion catalogue for women’s clothing, modest wear and kids’ apparel.

Website: https://bismiboutique.online/

## Women’s collections
- Three-piece sets
- Two-piece sets
- Shirts
- Kurtas
- Cotton wear
- Towels
- Burqa
- Burqa shawls

## Kids’ collections
- Girls’ co-ord sets
- Boys’ co-ord sets
- T-shirts
- Track pants
- Socks

## Product enquiry
Product cards are designed to start a product-specific WhatsApp enquiry after the boutique’s official WhatsApp number is configured.

## Important catalogue status
Product names, images and prices are demo placeholders and must be replaced with confirmed boutique data. There is no shopping cart and cash on delivery is not available. The intended order flow is Buy Now → WhatsApp → prepaid payment confirmation. Official WhatsApp/product links and payment method must be supplied and configured before ordering can go live. Newsletter subscriptions and official social profiles are not connected yet. The site has a no-return/no-exchange policy subject to rights that cannot legally be excluded.
